title: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
why_read: A command-line agent wrapper designed to run autonomously in the background and only interrupt the user for uncertain decisions, part of the growing autonomous coding agent trend.
analysis: This tool lets a command-line AI agent continue working on tasks in the background without constant supervision, only surfacing a decision card when it hits something uncertain that needs human judgment. This reflects a broader pattern in current agent tooling of trying to minimize interruption while preserving a human-in-the-loop safety valve for ambiguous situations. The approach is reasonable and practical, though the description doesn't specify what underlying model or safety guardrails are used.
